lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: When they arrived in Bethlehem, the barley harvest had just begun. Ruth spoke to Naomi with a plan.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.text: Let me go to the fields and pick up the grain left behind by anyone in whose eyes I find favor.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Ruth went out and gleaned in the field behind the harvesters. She happened to be working in a field belonging to Boaz, from the clan of Elimelek.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She gathered only what the law allowed—the grain left for the poor and the foreigner. Patiently, stalk by stalk, she filled her apron.

choices.label: Gather the fallen grain
choices.note: Ruth works with care, taking only what is left for gleaners.

choices.label: Rest briefly in the shade
choices.note: Even gleaners need a moment's rest under the harvest sun.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The sun rose higher. Ruth kept her head down and her hands steady. The field was generous to those who came last.
